_why: free-exercise-db files these under 'other', and mapEquipment turned every value it did not know into 'bodyweight': a trap bar deadlift in your own programme had no weight dial and saved 0 kg, the Bodyweight chip listed sled pushes, and a bodyweight-only coach plan could draw a yoke walk. Each lift here moves an external load and goes in the nearest bucket the filter chips have: barbell for bars and plates, dumbbell for what is held in the hands or hung from a belt, machine for sleds and strongman implements, which only a full gym has. Read by scripts/generate_free_exercise_library.mjs and checked against the generated library by tests/lib/libraryEquipment.test.cjs.
